_comment_bins: Absolute path per tool a SKILL.md declares via its `Bin path` metadata.
Advertised to the agent beside the skill so it invokes the tool directly
instead of relying on PATH - an agent's PATH is whatever the provider CLI
inherited, which is not something crustify controls.
_comment_prompt_capabilities: Prompt-only capability selection by agent role. A listed capability adds
its generic skill metadata and any Crustify role guidance to that agent's
system prompt. Omitting one does NOT hide its binary, dependency, path or
source from the agent's shell. An absent role list enables none.
Known translator capabilities: wavefront, ffibox, crustify-audit.
